In this video we cover:
JSW Cement’s IPO Amid Industry Headwinds
JSW Cement is launching a ₹3,600 crore IPO to fund expansion and reduce debt, at a time when big players like UltraTech and Adani are growing through acquisitions. Despite leading India’s green cement segment with 84% GGBS market share, JSW faces weak financials, rising debt, and heavy dependence on JSW Steel.
This IPO signals a bold move to stay competitive in an industry focused on consolidation.
